items.t: Introduced SR18 SD1, requesting a feasibility study on a rural health clinic or comparable access point for the Volcano community.
items.q: REQUESTING THE HAWAIʻI HEALTH SYSTEMS CORPORATION'S EAST HAWAIʻI REGIONAL HEALTH CARE SYSTEM TO CONDUCT A FEASIBILITY STUDY ON ESTABLISHING A RURAL HEALTH CLINIC OR COMPARABLE RURAL HEALTH ACCESS POINT TO SERVE THE VOLCANO COMMUNITY.

items.t: Introduced SCR32, requesting a task force to study marine life conservation district carrying capacity and develop a statewide implementation plan.
items.q: REQUESTING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A MARINE LIFE CONSERVATION DISTRICT CARRYING CAPACITY STUDY TASK FORCE TO DEVELOP A STATEWIDE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN.

items.t: Introduced SR16 SD1, requesting that the Division of Aquatic Resources work with the Department of Education and the State Public Charter School Commission on a student coral stewardship program framework.
items.q: REQUESTING THE DIVISION OF AQUATIC RESOURCES TO COLLABORATE WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION AND STATE PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL COMMISSION TO DEVELOP AND PROPOSE A FRAMEWORK FOR A STUDENT CORAL STEWARDSHIP PROGRAM.

items.t: Introduced SCR31, requesting that the Department of Transportation and the Department of Education evaluate and recommend improvements to licensing, training and the workforce pipeline for school bus drivers.
items.q: REQUESTING THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION, IN COORDINATION WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION, TO EVALUATE AND RECOMMEND IMPROVEMENTS TO THE LICENSING, TRAINING, AND WORKFORCE PIPELINE FOR SCHOOL BUS DRIVERS IN THE STATE.

items.t: Introduced SR17 SD1, expressing strong support for the County of Hawaiʻi's efforts to develop the Kealakehe Regional Park Project.
items.q: STRONGLY SUPPORTING THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI'S EFFORTS TO DEVELOP THE KEALAKEHE REGIONAL PARK PROJECT.
